task.title: P6-175: Fix set-picker and owned-badge test couplings
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-175. Size: S. Specs: specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Set-picker and owned-badge test couplings** (was `P6-036g` + `P6-036h` + `P6-036i` + `P6-038b` + `P6-038c` + `P6-038d` + `P6-042f`): `filter-rail.spec.ts:507-521`'s "a set pick drops the page cursor" has **no positive control** that the cursor was present on the loaded page; `a_code_the_picker_never_lists_is_still_the_users_selection` rewrites `"s:xyz"` using state derived from `read("s:xyz,mh3")` — two different fixtures, so it really only tests `toggle_code` + `set_term`; the repo's first `EitherOf4`-inside-`Suspend` is covered only by the passing probe, not by a targeted assertion; `catalog.spec.ts` picks `top`/`none` from a `limit=15` API call while the page renders `limit=50`, sound only because the ordering makes the first 15 a prefix of the first 50 — an undeclared coupling; its SSR pin `expect(html).toContain("${top.owned} owned")` is a whole-page substring check any other card with the same count satisfies; and `android-catalog-paging-check.mjs:93-103` step 4 asserts "no Next" but never that the pre-cursor card is absent, so it passes on a cursor-ignoring build (step 2 already does this correctly — copy that shape).
